comparisons.reason: Same source and any/binary/null rules, but different constructs. Feature 0 flags a concrete real-world example (case, event, person, personal experience). Feature 1 flags specific numerical data or statistics. A comment can give a specific real-world example with no numbers, and a comment can give a number with no specific case. Feature 1 explicitly treats non-quantitative examples as 0, so the two predicates are not interchangeable.
